summary: Frontend-only regression + fix-validation for Interiors gallery scroll jank fix (requestIdleCallback preload of GALLERY images). Verified preload happens before scroll reaches #interiors, every slide mounts with a fully decoded image (complete=true, naturalWidth>0), no black/empty frames, no console/page errors, counter recovers correctly after fast-scroll stress, and prior fixes (caption double-exposure, WAAPI offsets, ken-burns scale, first/last slide visibility) do not regress. Mobile portrait originals + desktop _wide.jpg selection logic both confirmed working.
critical_code_review_comments: Interiors.jsx preload effect correctly uses requestIdleCallback with setTimeout fallback and cancels on unmount — clean implementation.
prefersWideImages() is evaluated both in the preload effect and inside Slide render — consistent decision as long as viewport width isn't crossed post-preload; acceptable trade-off.
img.decode() promise catch is silent — fine for preloading.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Interiors fix validated end-to-end at 1920x800 and 390x844. Objective checks used: (1) performance.getEntriesByType('resource') confirmed all 5 wide images (desktop) or portrait images (mobile) fetched during the ~4s idle window before section reached; (2) at every slide boundary, `img.complete===true` and `naturalWidth=1920` (desktop wide) / 928 or 768 (mobile portrait); (3) 30-sample sweep across the 5x-viewport-tall section detected zero instances of two captions both above opacity 0.5 (double-exposure regression clean); (4) ken-burns scale transitions 1.08 → 1.02 on desktop; (5) first slide opacity=1 at section top, last slide opacity=1 at section bottom; (6) counter returns to 01 after scroll-up and 05 after scroll-down through stress positions; (7) zero console errors and no runtime error overlay across all tests.

desktop_1920x800.preload_before_scroll: ALL 5 wide JPEGs found in performance resources after 4.5s idle window (totalResources=34)
desktop_1920x800.slide_mount_state: slides 0..4 all had img.complete=true, naturalWidth=1920, naturalHeight=1288 when visited
desktop_1920x800.counter_after_fast_scroll_stress: 05 at bottom, 01 at top — recovered correctly

mobile_390x844.preload_before_scroll: All 5 portrait originals fetched, NO _wide.jpg fetched (correct selection)
mobile_390x844.slide_mount_state: slides 0..4 all had img.complete=true, portrait src loaded

rca of the issue: Not required — fix already applied by main agent and confirmed effective. Original jank came from per-slide mid-scroll fetch+decode of ~500KB 1920x1288 JPEGs; new idle-time preload+decode places them in the browser cache/decoded-image pool so assignment inside the mount window resolves synchronously without a decode hitch.
